svg.title: G&G City wizard cat (concept A2, with outlines and wand)
svg.desc: LAYERS (back to front): cape, tail, body, legs, arm-staff, arm-free, clasp, head-group (head, cheeks, hat, ears, eyes, eyelids, brows, nose, mouth), arm-free (with the wand). MOODS: set data-mood on the root svg to one of: idle, charging, success, fail, happy, sad, annoyed, lazy. POSES: set data-pose on the root svg to one of: idle (default), walk, sit, think, cast, cheer. Walk and cheer loop by themselves. EARS: set data-ears on the root svg to one of: sleeve (default), pocket, plain. GLOW: set data-glow on the root svg to one of: off, charge, success, fail (gold, green, red). Example: document.getElementById("cat").dataset.mood = "success". Changes to the original design: outlines, soft shading, blinking while idle, a small ear twitch and hat-star sway. WAND: the old staff and the fixed glow layer were replaced by a half-moon wand in the raised paw (#wand-mount; rotate #wand-pose to swing or aim it; #wand-gem glows in the --spell colour). The arm is drawn last so the wand is never hidden. #leg-back / #leg-front wrap the legs so C1's cat.js walk animation moves them.
